children: The five major networks have suspended pool coverage of the White House in solidarity with a decision by the Administration to bar reporters from CNN
, and Politico from the White House grounds.

On Saturday, Trump denied reporters from the three news organizations access to the White House and removed CNN from its duties as White House pool representative for TV networks for what the president considers negative coverage.

"They shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States." Trump said on social media. "I don't have to let them into my, into the people's house,” the president added, threatening to add additional news outlets to the ban.
The three networks have subsequently filed a legal challenge to President Trump’s ban, claiming the order violates the First Amendment.
In support of their colleagues, ABC

have suspended coverage and issued a joint statement reminding the administration that “the public has a vital interest in receiving accurate, independent information about its government. No administration should restrict a news organization because it objects to its reporting.”
All other pool coverage will continue as normal, including Congress, VIPs, and selected events in Washington and around the country.

title: Major networks suspend White House pool coverage in solidarity with banned reporters
